translations.web: “ ‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it. You shall not use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.
translations.bsb: You must not eat anything with blood still in it. You must not practice divination or sorcery.
translations.kjv: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.
